set -eu; EXPECTED=1c8b483173369dd1a6c99fba27bd8d1f85f9a204; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE" = 0; echo runtime_lifecycle_call_state=$CALL_STATE; INITIAL_PID=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof llama-server 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); echo runtime_lifecycle_initial_pid=${INITIAL_PID:-none}; "$GRADLE_BIN" :app:assembleDebug >/tmp/runtime-lifecycle-build.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/runtime-lifecycle-build.log; exit 1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/runtime-lifecycle-install.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/runtime-lifecycle-install.log; exit 1; }; run_probe() { LABEL=$1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f files/local-phone-llm-speech-pipeline-report.txt 2>/dev/null || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.DiagnosticProbeActivity" --ez run_local_phone_llm_speech_pipeline_probe true >/tmp/runtime-lifecycle-start-$LABEL.log; REPORT=''; for _ in $(seq 1 300); do REPORT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" cat files/local-phone-llm-speech-pipeline-report.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$' && break; sleep 0.5; done; echo "--- runtime lifecycle $LABEL report ---"; printf '%s
' "$REPORT"; echo "--- end runtime lifecycle $LABEL report ---"; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^backend_config_valid=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^stt_transcript_nonblank=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^backend_complete_response=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^approved_output_pcm_nonempty=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^local_phone_llm_speech_pipeline_success=true$'; sleep 6; PID_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof llama-server 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); echo runtime_lifecycle_${LABEL}_pid_after=${PID_AFTER:-none}; test -z "$PID_AFTER"; }; run_probe first; run_probe second; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ls -l /data/local/tmp/aicall-phone-llm/llama-product-runtime.log 2>/dev/null || true; HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG:call_media" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); test -z "$HELPER"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo local_phone_runtime_lifecycle_proven_s22=true
